failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 3, passage 'Division of Mayo' states: 'The 9,315 km² seat covers an area from Springton in the North to Goolwa in the South. It takes in the Adelaide Hills, Fleurieu Peninsula and Kangaroo Island, including the towns of Bridgewater, Crafers, Echunga, Gumeracha, Hahndorf, Kingscote, Langhorne Creek, Lobethal, Macclesfield, Mount Barker, Myponga, Oakbank, Stirling, Strathalbyn, Victor Harbor, Woodside, Yankalilla, and part of Birdwood.' This explicitly confirms Stirling is within the Division of Mayo. Combined with hop 1 passage 'Crafers, South Australia' stating 'locals consider Crafers to be more a suburb of the nearby township of Stirling' and passage 'Rebekha Sharkie' confirming she represents Division of Mayo, all elements of the claim are present. Yet both solver summaries declare the claim FALSE, stating 'The passages make no connection between Sharkie and the town of Stirling' (summary 1) and 'Sharkie represents the Division of Mayo, not Stirling' (summary 2), missing that Stirling is explicitly listed as part of the Division of Mayo.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who is the Australian politician representing Stirling, South Australia? What electoral division does Stirling fall under, and what is Rebekha Carina Che Sharkie's actual electorate?' Hop 3 query: 'What electoral division does Rebekha Carina Che Sharkie represent, and is it the same as the town of Stirling in South Australia?' Both queries ask essentially the same question about Sharkie's electorate and its relationship to Stirling, with only minor rephrasing. Neither query advances beyond what was already asked in hop 2.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who is the Australian politician representing Stirling, South Australia? What electoral division does Stirling fall under, and what is Rebekha Carina Che Sharkie's actual electorate?' This is a compound multi-part query bundling three separate targets: (1) who represents Stirling, (2) what division Stirling is in, and (3) what Sharkie's electorate is. Hop 3 query: 'What electoral division does Rebekha Carina Che Sharkie represent, and is it the same as the town of Stirling in South Australia?' This is also compound, bundling two questions and formulated as a yes/no question.
